messages:
Jia Li: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR with a compact cheat sheet for Dedicated provisioning. Focus is on: autoscale burst examples, tenant isolation label patterns, and an SLA scenario matrix. Need reviewers for accuracy + a short SDK snippet for the Node SDK.

Ben Thompson: link? happy to skim and fix wording.

Jia Li: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 — main file is docs/dedicated/cheat_sheet.md.

Alex Chen: skimmed the autoscale section. Question: the burst example uses a 30s cooldown — is that an enforcement policy or our recommendation? We should clarify.

Jia Li: Good call. It's a recommended cooldown applied by the default scale policy (not enforced by infra). I'll update language to "recommended default" and add an example config.

Samir Patel: For the SDK snippet, prefer showing both Terraform and the JS SDK. Small example for reserving a pool + attach policy would be great.

Jia Li: Added a tiny Terraform example and a JS snippet. Paste from the PR: 
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "fast" {
  name = "fast-embed-pool"
  gpu_count = 8
  region = "us-west-2"
}

resource "redwood_autoscale_policy" "burstable" {
  pool_id = redwood_dedicated_pool.fast.id
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 8
  burst_cooldown_seconds = 30
}
```

And the Node SDK snippet: 
```js
await redwood.dedicated.createPool({ name: 'fast-embed-pool', gpus: 8, region: 'us-west-2' })
await redwood.dedicated.createAutoscalePolicy(poolId, { min: 1, max: 8, burstCooldownSec: 30 })
```

Maria Gonzales: Looks good. Two tiny asks: 1) show the isolation label pattern we recommend (tenant:team=abc) and 2) in the SLA matrix row for "regional failover" call out fallback latency (90s) explicitly.

Jia Li: Will add an isolation example and call out fallback latency. Draft isolation line: `node_selector: { "redwood.tenant/label": "team:marketing" }` — does that align with infra labels?

Eli Carter: Slight tweak — infra currently expects `tenant_id` style: `redwood.tenant/id = "team-marketing"`. We should keep examples consistent with k8s label restrictions (no ":"). Also add a note about sanitization (replace spaces/colons with dashes).

Jia Li: Thanks, Eli. I'll change the example to `redwood.tenant/id: "team-marketing"` and add a label sanitization note.

Ben Thompson: Also flag: a link to the dedicated API reference is broken under "policy fields" — 404. I can fix that link in a follow-up commit if you want.

Jia Li: Please do, that would be great. I'll add a TODO in the PR for link fix and add you as owner.

docs-bot: PR #4567 opened by Jia Li — 4 files changed, 289 additions, 12 deletions. CI: docs-lint passed.

Alex Chen: One more: autoscale examples currently show integer GPUs only. Maybe add a short note about fractional CPU-backed instance types for soft quota tiers? Or that belongs in infra.md?

Samir Patel: Put a short note with a link to infra.md rather than expanding here — keeps cheat sheet compact.

Jia Li: Done. Added one-line note: "For soft-tier variants (fractional CPU/GPU mixes) see infra provisioning guide" + anchor to infra.md.

Maria Gonzales: Ready to approve once the isolation label and SLA fallback latency row are updated. I'll do a quick pass after those changes. :+1:

Jia Li: Thanks all — I'll push the edits in the next hour and ping again when ready for review.

Eli Carter: thanks! small win for oncall and docs.

Ben Thompson: nice — thanks for consolidating these examples, Jia.
